recap.title: Stoppage-Time Swings Leave Riverside and Northgate Level
recap.summary: Riverside FC and Northgate United finished 1-1 after a frantic stoppage-time sequence decided the match’s final shape. Northgate struck first in the 90+00:23 with a penalty from Jonas Torez, but Riverside replied at 90+04:41 through Kofi Kesero to rescue a point. The game stayed finely balanced throughout, with near-identical xG at 2.07 for Riverside FC and 2.05 for Northgate United, so the result was ultimately decided by late finishing rather than control. Northgate had more of the territory and final-third threat, but Riverside’s heavier possession in the closing minutes helped them survive long enough to equalise.
